scope: Paged and bounded reviewed backfill; controlled 100-turn continuity across whole-database backup/restore. Not complete product memory acceptance.

checks: Dump/restore plus a separate process resumes the saved extraction without another model call
Versioned batch recap survives full backup/restore and checkpoint resume with its ten source messages

Changed source text invalidates a completed recap even if IDs and event versions still match

Recovered memory is retrievable by real pgvector and retains message/event provenance
A 50-turn story restores its notes, successful batches and failed embedding checkpoint in a new process without re-extraction
100 confirmed turns span 20 persisted batches across backup/restore; the interrupted turn never enters derived memory
